title: User
description: used to display a name for the user
summary: User display component for showing names and identities.
shortDescription: The User component displays user identity information in a consistent format throughout the interface. Typically combines an Avatar with the user's name and optionally additional details like email or role. Used in headers to show the logged-in user, in comments to identify authors, in team member lists, or anywhere user attribution is needed. Supports various sizes and layouts to fit different contexts.
